title: TikTok Debut and Six Bad Openings
description: Steven livestreams to TikTok for the first time while recording, tours his gear and AI workflow, and weighs launching four English-teaching brands. He also previews a Slavic folk-tale Halloween audiobook and explains why he told his first-year students that all six of their favourite essay openings are banned.

sentences.zh: 内容速览
sentences.en: Content Overview

sentences.zh: 今天这期节目里，加拿大人史蒂文第一次尝试一边录播客，一边把画面直播到 TikTok。
sentences.en: In today's episode, Canadian Steven tries for the first time to record a podcast while livestreaming the video to TikTok.

sentences.zh: 他还带大家看了录音室里的设备和 AI 自动化流程，聊了他想推出的四个英语教学“品牌”，以及那个躲不开的问题：到底有没有人想要？
sentences.en: He also shows everyone the equipment in the studio and his AI automation workflow, talks about the four English-teaching "brands" he wants to launch, and the unavoidable question: does anyone actually want them?

sentences.zh: 接着是万圣节有声书计划、新片头的点子，还有他的大一学生听说自己最爱用的作文开头全被“禁用”后的反应。
sentences.en: Then come his Halloween audiobook plan, ideas for a new intro, and how his first-year students reacted on hearing that their favorite essay openings had all been "banned."

sentences.zh: TikTok 首播与过多的设备
sentences.en: TikTok premiere and too many devices

sentences.zh: 史蒂文今天想试点新鲜的：录播客的同时直播到 TikTok。
sentences.en: Today Steven wants to try something new: livestreaming to TikTok while recording the podcast.

sentences.zh: 在中国用 YouTube 直播基本行不通；Substack 能连上，画质却不理想；TikTok 稍好一些，就是容易分心。
sentences.en: Livestreaming on YouTube basically doesn't work in China; Substack can connect, but the picture quality isn't ideal; TikTok is a little better, it's just easy to get distracted.

sentences.zh: 眼下他面前有四块屏幕、三台摄像机、两支麦克风，硬盘更是东一个西一个：
sentences.en: Right now he has four screens, three cameras and two microphones in front of him, and hard drives scattered all over the place:

sentences.zh: iPad： 直接推流到 TikTok
sentences.en: iPad: streams directly to TikTok

sentences.zh: iPhone + 大疆麦克风： 为以后的竖屏短视频准备
sentences.en: iPhone + DJI microphone: for vertical short videos later

sentences.zh: MacBook 摄像头 + Shure 麦克风： 作为备份，音频版听到的就是它的声音
sentences.en: MacBook camera + Shure microphone: serves as a backup; its sound is what you hear in the audio version

sentences.zh: AI 工作流与“变橙”事故
sentences.en: The AI workflow and the 'turning orange' incident

sentences.zh: 史蒂文搭了一套 AI 工作流：把视频文件扔进文件夹，后面的事就全自动了。
sentences.en: Steven built an AI workflow: drop a video file into a folder, and everything after that is fully automatic.

sentences.zh: 系统会转写节目，生成 JSON、TXT 和 SRT 文件，翻译成中文和俄语，再做出 MP3。
sentences.en: The system transcribes the episode, generates JSON, TXT and SRT files, translates it into Chinese and Russian, and then makes an MP3.

sentences.zh: 这个周末他还用“凭感觉编程”的方式做了自己的视频控制台。
sentences.en: This weekend he also built his own video control panel by 'vibe coding'.

sentences.zh: 不过出了个小麻烦：Blackmagic 相机应用锁死了白平衡，太阳一落山，只剩室内橙色灯光，他整个人越来越橙。
sentences.en: But there was a small problem: the Blackmagic camera app locked the white balance, so once the sun set and only the orange indoor lights were left, he got more and more orange.

sentences.zh: 用他的话说：“‘你这期怎么这么橙？在中国待久了吧。’我已经能想象评论区了。”
sentences.en: In his words: "'Why are you so orange this episode? Been in China too long, huh?' I can already picture the comments section."

sentences.zh: 英语“超级文件夹”、加里·维和盖蒂
sentences.en: The English "super folder", Gary Vee and Getty

sentences.zh: 这个周末最大的突破，是一个英语教学“超级文件夹”，里面装着他十八年教学生涯的资料。
sentences.en: The biggest breakthrough this weekend was an English-teaching "super folder" holding the materials from his eighteen-year teaching career.

sentences.zh: 内容已经齐了，卡住他的是发布。
sentences.en: The content is all there; what's holding him back is publishing it.

sentences.zh: 他认同加里·维纳查克的看法：与其“喝酒、打游戏、抱怨工作却什么都不改变”，不如去做直播、写 Substack 文章。
sentences.en: He agrees with Gary Vaynerchuk: rather than "drinking, playing video games, and complaining about work without changing anything," it's better to livestream and write Substack articles.

sentences.zh: 如今有了 AI 智能体，“如果我一年内还做不成，那不是事情做不成，而是我自己做不成。”
sentences.en: Now that there are AI agents, "if I still can't do it within a year, it's not that it can't be done, it's that I couldn't do it."

sentences.zh: 不过教英语有个难处：卖课程要耗掉自己的时间，而且出于隐私，课堂往往不能录像。
sentences.en: But teaching English has a difficulty: selling courses eats up your own time, and for privacy reasons, classes often can't be recorded.

sentences.zh: 这让他想起挂在公寓里的盖蒂名言：企业的核心目标，是以更低的成本，为更多人提供更好的产品或服务。
sentences.en: This reminded him of the Getty quote hanging in his apartment: the core goal of a business is to provide better products or services to more people at a lower cost.

sentences.zh: 四个品牌、多个平台，和一个大问题
sentences.en: Four brands, multiple platforms, and one big problem

sentences.zh: 那么，他比别的老师强在哪？
sentences.en: So what makes him better than other teachers?

sentences.zh: 内容创作。
sentences.en: Content creation.

sentences.zh: “我知道怎么按下直播键。”
sentences.en: “I know how to press the ‘go live’ button.”

sentences.zh: 他的工作流会把录音切成习语、固定搭配和句型。
sentences.en: His workflow chops recordings into idioms, set collocations and sentence patterns.

sentences.zh: 如今 AI 几乎能包办动画制作，现在不做，更待何时？
sentences.en: These days AI can handle almost all of animation production — if not now, when?

sentences.zh: 四个“品牌”：
sentences.en: Four “brands”:

sentences.zh: 基础英语： 面向初学者的练习，放 TikTok、Instagram。
sentences.en: Basic English: practice for beginners, posted on TikTok and Instagram.

sentences.zh: 雅思备考： 单独的 TikTok 账号，课程初稿已经有了。
sentences.en: IELTS prep: a separate TikTok account; a first draft of the course already exists.

sentences.zh: 英语 vlog： 给中级学习者的易懂英语，主要在 YouTube 和播客。
sentences.en: English vlog: comprehensible English for intermediate learners, mainly on YouTube and podcasts.

sentences.zh: 史蒂文的语言博客： 他正在直播的 YouTube 频道。
sentences.en: Steven's Language Blog: the YouTube channel he's livestreaming on right now.

sentences.zh: 同时运营这些账号，让他的 Instagram 被封，TikTok 今天还逼他做了验证。
sentences.en: Running all these accounts at once got his Instagram banned, and today TikTok also made him go through verification.

sentences.zh: 基础英语最难：他自己也不想教基础英语，也许可以出一本《漫画学英语》。
sentences.en: Basic English is the hardest: he doesn't really want to teach basic English himself; maybe he could put out a book, “Learn English Through Comics.”

sentences.zh: 然后是最难的问题：“有人想要吗？有人买吗？”
sentences.en: Then comes the hardest question: “Does anyone want it? Will anyone buy it?”

sentences.zh: 万圣节有声书：斯拉夫风格，小众冷门
sentences.en: Halloween audiobook: Slavic style, niche and obscure

sentences.zh: 万圣节在周六。
sentences.en: Halloween is on Saturday.

sentences.zh: 每年他都会录一本万圣节有声书：爱伦·坡的《黑猫》和《泄密的心》，两年前的《聊斋》，去年的《猴爪》。
sentences.en: Every year he records a Halloween audiobook: Edgar Allan Poe's "The Black Cat" and "The Tell-Tale Heart", "Strange Tales from a Chinese Studio" two years ago, and "The Monkey's Paw" last year.

sentences.zh: 今年的提示是“斯拉夫，小众”：乌克兰民间故事，里面有变形者、精灵和女巫。
sentences.en: This year's prompt was "Slavic, niche": Ukrainian folk tales featuring shapeshifters, spirits and witches.

sentences.zh: 大多数篇目都超过 40 分钟，所以他打算分开发布，最后一篇周五作为特别版推出。
sentences.en: Most of the stories run over 40 minutes, so he plans to release them separately, with the last one coming out Friday as a special edition.

sentences.zh: 《美国众神》、有声书网站与新片头
sentences.en: American Gods, an audiobook website and a new intro

sentences.zh: 他快听完《美国众神》了。
sentences.en: He has almost finished listening to American Gods.

sentences.zh: 再加上周末一期火药味十足的 No Agenda 节目，他开始怀疑：沉重的话题之后，真的还想接一本有声书吗？
sentences.en: On top of that, after a fiery episode of No Agenda over the weekend, he began to wonder: after such heavy topics, does he really want to start another audiobook?

sentences.zh: 他还想给有声书单独建个网站。
sentences.en: He also wants to build a separate website for the audiobooks.

sentences.zh: 有声书全部免费，想支持的话，节目说明里有 PayPal 链接。
sentences.en: The audiobooks are all free; if you want to support them, there's a PayPal link in the show notes.

sentences.zh: 片头方面，他今天写了一句押韵词：“Back into class and how did it go? Now we're discussing how arguments grow.”也许可以学 No Agenda，先来一段节目精华，再接一段气势十足的音乐。
sentences.en: As for the intro, today he wrote a rhyme: "Back into class and how did it go? Now we're discussing how arguments grow." Maybe he could follow No Agenda's lead: start with a highlight from the show, then go into a powerful piece of music.

segments.zh: Back into class and how did it go? Now we're discussing how arguments grow.

sentences.zh: 议论文与六个糟糕的开头
sentences.en: Argumentative essays and six bad openings

sentences.zh: 他的大一学生正在学五段式议论文：引言、反方观点、反驳、论证、结论。
sentences.en: His first-year students are learning the five-paragraph argumentative essay: introduction, counterargument, rebuttal, argument, conclusion.

sentences.zh: 现在是第八周，期中考试在第十周。
sentences.en: It's now week eight, and the midterm is in week ten.

sentences.zh: 他给学生看了六个开头句，后来告诉他们：全都不行：
sentences.en: He showed the students six opening sentences, then told them: none of them work:

sentences.zh: 1. 太显而易见：“肥胖是喝太多软饮料造成的大问题。”
sentences.en: 1. Too obvious: "Obesity is a big problem caused by drinking too many soft drinks."

sentences.zh: 2. 反问句。
sentences.en: 2. Rhetorical questions.

sentences.zh: “为什么不呢？”
sentences.en: "Why not?"

sentences.zh: 因为这是大学。
sentences.en: Because this is college.

sentences.zh: 3. 把软饮料的“毒害”说得太夸张。
sentences.en: 3. Exaggerating the "poison" of soft drinks.

sentences.zh: 4. 没人能反驳的空话套话。
sentences.en: 4. Empty clichés that no one could argue with.

sentences.zh: 5. 谚语：“一天一苹果，医生远离我。”
sentences.en: 5. Proverbs: "An apple a day keeps the doctor away."

sentences.zh: 6. “众所周知，随着科技的发展……”
sentences.en: 6. "As everyone knows, with the development of technology..."

sentences.zh: “随着科技的发展”一定要删掉，因为“没有什么比它更像背出来的标准答案”。
sentences.en: "With the development of technology" must be cut, because "nothing sounds more like a memorized stock answer."

sentences.zh: “这是不是吹毛求疵？可能吧。欢迎来到学术写作。”
sentences.en: "Is this nitpicking? Maybe. Welcome to academic writing."

sentences.zh: 周五计划：把作文“说”出来
sentences.en: Friday's plan: "speak" the essay out loud

sentences.zh: 他承认自己有个疏漏：没讲过怎么把糟糕的开头改好，所以有几个学生照样用了。
sentences.en: He admits he made an oversight: he never explained how to fix a bad opening, so a few students used one anyway.

sentences.zh: 所以周五，学生可以先抛出那个反问句，过过瘾，接下来写的内容，说不定才是真正的开头。
sentences.en: So on Friday, students can first throw out that rhetorical question and get it out of their system; what they write next might be the real opening.

sentences.zh: 然后两人一组辩论，把对话录音、转写，再改写成正文第一到第三段。
sentences.en: Then they debate in pairs, record and transcribe the conversation, and rewrite it into body paragraphs one through three.

sentences.zh: 这和他写 Substack 文章、搭 AI 工作流是同一个思路。
sentences.en: It's the same approach he uses for writing Substack articles and building AI workflows.

sentences.zh: 到目前为止，还没人在他的课上睡着。
sentences.en: So far, no one has fallen asleep in his class.

sentences.zh: “再给他们点时间。”
sentences.en: "Give them a little more time."

sentences.zh: 今日总结
sentences.en: Today's summary

sentences.zh: 不管是史蒂文的四个品牌，还是学生的议论文，最难的都是迈出第一步，而最简单的办法，也许就是先开口说出来。
sentences.en: Whether it's Steven's four brands or students' essays, the hardest part is always taking the first step, and the simplest way may be to just start by saying it out loud.

vocab.en: to stream / push a live feed

vocab.py: dōng yí ge xī yí ge
